subject: Starnet pilot: commercial onramp, payment route & security gating
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Sam Toliver <sam.toliver@starnet.io>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-20T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: Starnet pilot: commercial onramp, payment route & security gating

Hi Sam — thanks again for the demo this morning. Quick recap and concrete asks so we can get the pilot paperwork moving:  

Summary: Starnet is interested in a 6-week evaluation for the recommender flow we showed. Primary procurement questions are: preferred payment instrument (PO vs corporate card vs marketplace billing), timing for SOC 2 & DPA evidence, and any blockers from your security team around our questionnaire.

Asks / next steps:  
- Can you confirm whether Procurement prefers a PO (standard for enterprise) or card for initial billing? If PO, please share the procurement contact and typical PO timeline.  
- I’ve attached our redacted SOC 2 Type II and a DPA draft for initial review — let us know if you need further scope. (attachments: Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_redacted.pdf, Redwood_DPA_draft_v1.docx)
- If your security team needs us to complete a custom questionnaire, can you send the latest template? We can commit to a 3-business-day turnaround for the standard sections.  
- Marketplace option: we can also enable marketplace billing for faster procurement (no PO), but that requires your team to accept vendor terms and might change invoicing. Let us know if Marketplace is acceptable.

Proposed commercial route (recommended): Start with a short, paid pilot charged by card to avoid procurement delay; simultaneously route PO/DPA for long-term contract replacement. We’ll provide a simple MSA + SOW for PO execution.

Timing: If we can confirm payment route by Friday (2026-02-23), we can target activation the week of 2026-03-02.

I’ve copied Karthik to own the commercial paperwork and Ben for security artifacts. Happy to jump on a 20-min call if that helps.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0199

Attachments (2): Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_redacted.pdf (PDF, redacted), Redwood_DPA_draft_v1.docx (DOCX)

From: Sam Toliver <sam.toliver@starnet.io>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@starnet.io>
Date: 2026-02-20T11:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Starnet pilot: commercial onramp, payment route & security gating

Hi Laura — great session, thanks. Short answers below and a couple of clarifying Qs:  

1) Payment route: Procurement will prefer a PO for anything that flows through our committed budget (likely for production). For a short evaluation/pilot, they’ll accept a corporate card charge but will need to see SOC 2 and DPA language before approving a PO. I’ve looped Procurement on this thread.

2) Security evidence: procurement requested our security lead review your SOC 2 and DPA. They also want a completed security questionnaire (I’ll attach the one we use) — our timeline is tight: we need papers in place by mid-March to include in our Q1 vendor slate.

3) Marketplace: Marketplace is interesting but procurement has to confirm whether marketplace billing satisfies our internal vendor onboarding (sometimes not for larger spend).

Questions for Redwood:  
- Can you do a pay-by-card trial and then switch to PO within 30 days?
- What’s your standard turnaround on a filled security questionnaire (days to turnaround; are technical contacts available)?

I’ll get Procurement to share the questionnaire and the relevant procurement contact (procurement@starnet.io). Thanks,
Sam
Head of Product Partnerships | Starnet
sam.toliver@starnet.io

Attachment: Starnet_Security_Questionnaire_v3.docx

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-20T11:22:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: Starnet pilot: commercial onramp, payment route & security gating

Forwarding Sam’s reply — procurement looped in and they want SOC 2 + DPA + completed questionnaire before approving a PO. Key notes / proposed internal owners:  

- Karthik: own commercial (MSA + PO path). We should propose card-first invoicing for the pilot (low lift) and a firm date to convert to PO once DPA signed. Provide an estimated quote + SOW for procurement.
- Ben: own security artifacts and questionnaire completion. If we can commit to 3 business day turnaround on majority of questionnaire and 5-7 days for any technical follow-ups, that should fit their March timeline.

Suggested immediate actions:  
1) Send Sam a short proposal: pilot scope, pricing, and two billing options (card now / PO later). Include HubSpot link and deal id RDW-2379 so procurement can trace.
2) Ben, review their questionnaire and estimate technical response time.
3) Karthik, prepare templated MSA + SOW that we can route for PO execution; consider giving a 30-day transition clause from card to PO.

I’ll draft the initial proposal and attach SOC2 + DPA.

—Laura

Hi Sam / Laura — thanks for the clarity. Short commercial plan and concrete next steps so everyone has alignment:  

Commercial options (choose one):
A) Card-first pilot (recommended for speed) — 6-week paid pilot charged to a corporate card. We’ll provision access within 48 hours of payment. Within 30 days of pilot start, Starnet signs PO/MSA to replace card billing for ongoing use.
B) PO-first (longer path) — we can generate an MSA + SOW and scope signature to PO terms; PO route typically takes 2–4 weeks after Procurement receives SOC 2 + DPA + questionnaire.

Security & compliance timeline:  
- SOC 2: redacted copy attached here (https://drive.redwood.ai/soc2/rdw_redacted_v2.pdf).
- DPA: draft attached (we can expedite review through DocuSign; link: https://app.docusign.com/envelope/EXAMPLE-12345).
- Questionnaire: Ben will lead answers; typical turnaround for the standard vendor template is 3 business days, 5–7 days including technical follow-ups.

Action items (owners & ETA):
- Starnet: confirm preferred billing route and provide procurement contact (Sam / Procurement) — by EOD 2026-02-24.
- Redwood (Karthik): send a short proposal + pricing options and templated MSA/SOW with 30-day transition clause — by 2026-02-24.
- Redwood (Ben): start questionnaire review and post any clarifying Qs to Procurement — initial pass by 2026-02-25.
